summary: Iteration 33 - Bug Fixes Testing Complete. All 16 backend tests passed after fixing duplicate endpoint conflicts. All UI features verified via Playwright. Key fixes: 1) Course enrollment now works for org_admin/teacher/student roles, 2) Bulk enrollment no longer requires course_id - enrolls into organization with temp passwords, 3) PUT/DELETE courses work for org_admin with proper authorization, 4) Course Manage page fully functional with edit/delete/upload features.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed duplicate PUT/DELETE /api/courses/{course_id} endpoints - removed old restrictive versions from api_router that were overriding the proper courses_router versions
Added 'created_by' field to course creation to properly track course ownership for update/delete authorization
seed_data_creation: Created test courses and bulk enrolled test users during testing (auto-cleaned)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All bug fixes from iteration 33 are working. Key verifications: 1) POST /api/courses/{id}/enroll works for student/teacher/org_admin roles and auto-creates student_profile if none exists, 2) POST /api/org/bulk-enroll no longer requires course_id - enrolls into organization with temp passwords and email notifications, role selector supports student/teacher, 3) PUT /api/courses/{id} updates course title/description for org_admin/creator, 4) DELETE /api/courses/{id} deletes course and related lessons for org_admin/creator, 5) POST /api/courses/{id}/lessons adds lessons to courses, 6) POST /api/courses/{id}/generate-lessons-from-content endpoint exists for AI lesson generation, 7) Course Manage page at /course-manage/{courseId} fully functional with edit/delete/upload features, 8) Courses page shows 'Manage Course' button for org_admin, 9) Org Admin Dashboard bulk enroll dialog has role selector and no course selector.
